offering.serviceDescription: DEMONSTRATION DECLARATION, NOT A SUBMISSION. rampscan is an appliance a cloud service provider deploys inside its own AWS account to produce signed, commit-anchored pipeline evidence for FedRAMP 20x key security indicators; it is not itself a cloud service offering pursuing certification. This block exists so the self-scan exercises the Q5 schema-target exports end to end against its own ledger, the same way the repository dogfoods every other surface. A real provider replaces every field here with its own.

report.acceptedVulnerabilities: None accepted. This is a demonstration declaration for the self-scan, not a certification package: no risk-acceptance determination has been made about any finding, and the validation-failure records the ledger does hold are reported as VDR-CSO-FAV records in x-rampscan.validationVulnerabilities rather than as accepted vulnerabilities.
